title: Zero-point drives work as time machines
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Zero-point drives work as time machines, about contemporary at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Michael Masters goes into this in his book on UFOs and time travel which I cite in closer encounters

plain: A philosopher, Jason Jorjani, told podcast host Jesse Michels that a zero-point drive, an engine said to draw power from the energy of empty space, would also work as a time machine. He says a writer named Michael Masters covers this in his book on UFOs and time travel, which Jorjani cites in his own book, Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean UFOs could be visitors from other times as well as other places.
